summary: Stream complete agents publications with bounded snapshot chunks and revision-fenced changes

replay.detail: Only the current publication is available. Reconnect and resubscribe start with a complete snapshot. No replay log is added.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, migrations or claim schemas change. The client contract adds an explicit revisioned agents subscription and typed publication frames.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: The revisioned agents stream is opt-in. Legacy HTTP and WebSocket payloads remain unchanged. New clients can request complete snapshots and use epoch and base revision to fence changes. The collections.agents.revisioned.v1 capability requires read.projections.

downtime.detail: An ordinary binary upgrade restart starts a new publication epoch. No additional interruption is required.

manual.detail: Existing installations require no configuration or state changes.

recovery.detail: Returning to the previous binary requires no database rollback. Clients without the capability continue to use legacy subscriptions.
